description: This Dart source file provides a helper class 'LocalNotifications' for managing local notifications in a Flutter application. It handles initialization, displaying notifications with action buttons, and processing user interactions such as opening saved articles or undoing saves. It also encodes/decodes notification payloads to pass article data between the notification and app state.

classes.name: LocalNotifications
classes.description: A helper class for managing local notifications including their initialization, display, and response handling within a Flutter app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the local notifications plugin, sets up notification channels, and registers response handlers. Should be called once at app startup.

methods.name: showSavedArticleNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating an article has been saved, with action buttons for opening saved articles or undoing the save.

methods.name: _toPayloadJson
methods.description: Serializes a NewsArticle object to JSON map for use as notification payload.

methods.name: _articleFromPayload
methods.description: Deserializes notification payload into a NewsArticle object if possible.

methods.name: _handleAction
methods.description: Processes notification action responses, routing to navigation or undoing save actions based on the action ID.

methods.name: _onDidReceiveNotificationResponse
methods.description: Callback invoked when a notification response is received; delegates to handle action.

methods.name: _onDidReceiveBackgroundNotificationResponse
methods.description: Callback for handling notification responses in background; processes actions like undo.
